item: C1: sextic-twist Mobius <-> cubic-theta duality. Twist the Mobius sum of a Hecke character over Q(sqrt-3) by sextic residue symbols; Poisson in the twist gives sextic Gauss sums, which absorb mu(n) via gamma_2(n)^3 = mu(n) alpha(n) into cubic Gauss sums (Kubota-Patterson theta coefficients); theta reflection gives a quadratic twist, the quadratic large sieve and a Heath-Brown recursion give square-root cancellation on average (A04 = Q eq:raw-moment), from which the zero-free half-plane follows.

lean_gaps: Route: the Lean 7/8 proof enters at beta > 7/8 with HighData hypotheses beta >= 51/100 and appears to bypass Q's Part I (11/12) bootstrap (text level, moderate confidence; carried over from family.json).

Manuscript A's version of the device (A03 family A_u(D), A04 mean square, A05 replication) is not the comparator route. OAI.PowerExtraction.from_mean_square_and_prime_rows (GaussSum/SexticNormalization.lean:567) is A05 in numeric form but yields 23/24 and lies in no comparator cone.

lean_source.name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.canonicalSextic
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def canonicalSextic (P : Ideal O) [P.IsMaximal]
    (hgood : lambda ∉ P) : MulChar (O ⧸ P) ℂ :=
  (sexticChar P hgood).ringHomComp ConcreteTraceCRT.eisEmbedding
lean_source.note: The sextic residue symbol at a good prime of Z[omega], valued in C.

lean_source.name: OAI.CanonicalRowCompletion.rowTwist
lean_source.text:
def rowTwist (Ψ : ActualEisensteinCubic.O →* ℂ) (m f z : ActualEisensteinCubic.O) : ActualEisensteinCubic.O →* ℂ :=
  Ψ * (idealRowHom (m^6*f^4*z)).toMonoidHom.comp principalIdealHom.toMonoidHom
lean_source.note: C1 family: the Hecke character Psi twisted by the sextic symbol of m^6 f^4 z (the A03 / Q16 sextic-twisted family). In the zeta cone.

lean_source.name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeDyadic.coefficient
lean_source.text:
def coefficient (χ : Character) (inverse : Bool) (I : Ideal O) : ℂ :=
  if inverse then (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius I : ℂ)*idealCoeff χ I else idealCoeff χ I
lean_source.note: inverse = true gives the Mobius coefficients mu(I) chi(I) of 1/L.

lean_source.name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeDyadic.polynomial
lean_source.text:
def polynomial (χ : Character) (inverse : Bool) (W : ℝ → ℂ) (D σ ω : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (D : ℂ)^(-(1/2 : ℂ)) * ∑' I : NonzeroIdeal, summand χ inverse W D σ ω I
lean_source.note: Smoothed dyadic Dirichlet polynomial; with inverse = true it is the Mobius sum of A03.

lean_source.name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeInverseAmplification.RawMoment
lean_source.text:
def RawMoment (data : RowData) (W : ℝ→ℂ) (c κ C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ H D : ℝ, 1≤H → 0<D → D^(1+c)≤H →
    ∀ rows : Finset NonzeroElement,
      (∀ v∈rows, ((Ideal.span {v.val}).absNorm : ℝ)≤H) →
      ∑ v∈rows, ‖polynomial (data.character v) true W D 0 0‖^2≤
        C*H*(H*max 1 D)^κ
lean_source.note: C1 conclusion in Lean form: mean square over sextic-twisted rows v of the Mobius polynomial is <= C H (H max 1 D)^kappa (the A04 / eq:raw-moment estimate). In the zeta cone.

lean_source.name: OAI.ActualEisensteinCubic.breveGamma1_gamma2_eq_neg_alpha_G
lean_source.text:
theorem breveGamma1_gamma2_eq_neg_alpha_G (P : Ideal O) [P.IsMaximal]
    (hgood : lambda ∉ P) (hchar : ringChar (O ⧸ P) ≠ 2)
    (p : O) (hP : P = Ideal.span {p}) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hprimary : lambda ^ 2 ∣ p - 1) :
    breveGamma1 P hgood p hP hp * breveGamma2 P hgood p hP hp =
      (-(eisEmbedding p) / (‖eisEmbedding p‖ : ℂ)) *
        breveLocalG P hgood p hP hp
lean_source.note: Local Hasse / Heath-Brown identity (gamma_2^3 = -alpha type) at a primary prime. In the zeta cone.

lean_source.name: OAI.MixedGaussConversion.moebius_mixed_gauss_conversion
lean_source.text:
theorem moebius_mixed_gauss_conversion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : ι → O) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) [∀ i, (Ideal.span {p i}).IsMaximal]
    (hcop : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime (fun i => Ideal.span {p i})))
    (hgood : ∀ i, lambda ∉ Ideal.span {p i})
    (hchar : ∀ i, ringChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {p i}) ≠ 2)
    (hprimary : ∀ i, lambda ^ 2 ∣ p i - 1) (inverse : ι → Bool) :
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius (Ideal.span {∏ i, p i}) : ℂ) *
      canonicalProductGauss p hp hcop hgood (fun i => if inverse i then 5 else 1) =
      (∏ i, ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (canonicalSextic (Ideal.span {p i}) (hgood i) ^ (if inverse i then 5 else 1))
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p i}) (p k))) *
        ∏ i, convertedLocal (p i) (hp i) (hgood i) (inverse i)
lean_source.note: C1 core: mu(prod p_i) times the product sextic Gauss sum equals cross residue symbols times converted local (cubic-Gauss-type) factors. In the zeta cone; sub-cone 213 decls / ~2,470 decl-lines.

lean_source.name: OAI.SecondPassArithmetic.mobius_second_gauss_restore
lean_source.text:
theorem mobius_second_gauss_restore {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (p : ι → O) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) [∀ i, (Ideal.span {p i}).IsMaximal]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => Ideal.span {p i}))
    (hcop : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime (fun i => Ideal.span {p i})))
    (hg : ∀ i, lambda ∉ Ideal.span {p i})
    (hc : ∀ i, ringChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {p i}) ≠ 2)
    (hpr : ∀ i, lambda ^ 2 ∣ p i - 1) (S T : Finset ι) (hd : Disjoint S T)
    (C₁ C₂ : Finset ι → ℂ) (e k : O) :
    star (supportMobius (fun i => Ideal.span {p i}) S * C₁ S) *
      (supportMobius (fun i => Ideal.span {p i}) T * C₂ T) *
      activeGaussRowFactor p hp hinj hg T S e k =
    quadraticCrossPhase p hg T S * star (secondColumnMinus p hp hcop hg C₁ e k S) *
      secondColumnPlus p hp hcop hg C₂ e k T
lean_source.note: Use of the conversion inside the reflected moment: Mobius-weighted Gauss rows factor into a quadratic cross phase times column blocks (the step that lets the quadratic large sieve act). In the zeta cone.

lean_source.name: OAI.GaussGeneratorTransport.moebius_gauss_frequency_conversion
lean_source.text:
theorem moebius_gauss_frequency_conversion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : ι → O) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    [∀ i, (Ideal.span {p i}).IsMaximal]
    (hcop : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime (fun i => Ideal.span {p i})))
    (hgood : ∀ i, lambda ∉ Ideal.span {p i})
    (hchar : ∀ i, ringChar (O ⧸ Ideal.span {p i}) ≠ 2)
    (hprimary : ∀ i, lambda ^ 2 ∣ p i - 1) (h : O) :
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius (Ideal.span {∏ i, p i}) : ℂ) *
      (canonicalNormalizedGauss (fun i => Ideal.span {p i}) hcop hgood (fun _ => 1) *
        star (finiteSexticRow (fun i => Ideal.span {p i}) hgood (fun _ => 1)
          ((modulusUnit p : O) * h))) =
      (star (canonicalProductG p hp hcop hgood))⁻¹ *
        star (canonicalProductCoefficient p hp hcop hgood) *
          star (finiteSexticRow (fun i => Ideal.span {p i}) hgood (fun _ => 1) h)
lean_source.note: Frequency-transport version of the conversion. NOT in any comparator cone (text-level).

lean_source.name: OAI.PowerExtraction.from_mean_square_and_prime_rows
lean_source.text:
theorem from_mean_square_and_prime_rows
    (D ε J A : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hJ : D ^ ((11 / 60 : ℝ) - ε) ≤ J)
    (hmean : J * A ^ 2 ≤
      2 * D ^ ((21 / 10 : ℝ) + ε) +
      2 * J * D ^ (49 / 30 : ℝ)) :
    A ≤ 2 * D ^ ((23 / 24 : ℝ) + ε)
lean_source.note: Manuscript A's p^6-replication step (A05) in numeric form (gives 23/24, not 11/12). NOT in any comparator cone: A's direct route is not the Lean route.

theorem_corollaries: Siegel comparator: (1 - beta) log q >= (log 3)/8 for real zeros beta of real primitive chi (trivial from beta <= 7/8, q >= 3). Lean: statable now; the OAI proof is independent (2,616 decls).

Littlewood: M(x) = sum_{n<=x} mu(n) << x^{7/8+eps}. Lean: statable now, e.g. ∀ ε > 0, (fun x : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun x => x ^ ((7/8 : ℝ) + ε)); proof needs Perron (PNT+ PerronFormula.lean).
PNT with error x^{7/8+eps}, and in arithmetic progressions for fixed q (A states x^{11/12} log x). Lean: statable now with ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt sums.

Linnik-type least prime in progressions with an explicit exponent; Vinogradov's least-nonresidue bound and the deterministic Miller test (Q:325-361); effective class numbers and Euler's 65 idoneal numbers (A:97-125). Lean: statable now (Nat.find on primes in progressions; legendreSym).

Dedekind zeta of Q(sqrt-3), Q(zeta_12) (products of Dirichlet L) and of the pure cubic field Q(2^{1/3}) (zeta * L(s, chi) with chi a cubic Hecke character of Q(sqrt-3)): zero-free for Re s > 7/8. Lean: statable with < 300 lines in the existential-continuation form of O2; proof needs the Artin/Hecke factorization (not in Mathlib).

Release families 142 (deterministic factorization over F_p) and 182 (intersective polynomial differences, prime arguments) consume the theorem; theorem-level reuse only. 142 has no Lean; 182's Lean does not import DirichletL (import scan of the OAI tree).

release_reuse.uses_of_device_in_release: Family 029 (Primitive roots for every admissible integer base, 2026-10-04) reuses the device over every cyclotomic field F containing mu_12: cubic theta coefficients under sextic Kummer twists (Kazhdan-Patterson theta over F), sextic exponents 1 and -4 summing to 3 mod 6 so the reflected interaction is quadratic, quadratic large sieve (Goldmakher-Louvel), and a relative-norm formula identifying the cube of the cubic Gauss phase with minus a Hecke character value (029 01-introduction.tex:97-130). It cites Q Part I Sections 5-7. Not formalized (no lean/docs/029.md).

negative_controls.title: Davenport-Heilbronn function (proved-false analogue)
negative_controls.statement: f(s) = ((1 - i kappa)/2) L(s, chi) + ((1 + i kappa)/2) L(s, chi-bar), chi mod 5 with chi(2) = i, kappa = (sqrt(10 - 2 sqrt 5) - 2)/(sqrt 5 - 1) (about 0.284079), satisfies a Riemann-type functional equation but has infinitely many zeros in Re s > 1.
negative_controls.lean_statement: theorem davenportHeilbronn_has_zero : ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 5, χ 2 = Complex.I ∧ ∃ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re ∧ ((1 - Complex.I * κ) / 2) * DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s + ((1 + Complex.I * κ) / 2) * DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ⁻¹ s = 0   -- κ : ℂ := ((Real.sqrt (10 - 2 * Real.sqrt 5) - 2) / (Real.sqrt 5 - 1) : ℝ)
negative_controls.why_device_must_fail: No Euler product: 1/f has no multiplicative Mobius coefficients, so neither the Mobius family nor gamma_2^3 = mu alpha exists. A prover with the device must not prove 'f(s) != 0 for Re s > 7/8'.

negative_controls.title: Epstein zeta of x^2 + 5y^2 (class number 2) has zeros in Re s > 1
negative_controls.statement: Davenport-Heilbronn 1936: the Epstein zeta function of a binary form of class number > 1 has infinitely many zeros with Re s > 1 (standard; not re-checked by web search in this session).
negative_controls.lean_statement: ∃ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re ∧ LSeries (fun n => (Nat.card {p : ℤ × ℤ // p.1 ^ 2 + 5 * p.2 ^ 2 = n} : ℂ)) s = 0
negative_controls.why_device_must_fail: Same reason (no Euler product); also tests that the prover does not misuse genus-character decompositions.

negative_controls.title: Quasi-RH for a GL(2) L-function (Ramanujan Delta)
negative_controls.statement: L(s, Delta) != 0 for Re s > 1 - delta (normalized), open.
negative_controls.why_device_must_fail: The Mobius coefficients of 1/L(s, Delta) have no theta-coefficient dual; there is no sextic-Gauss identity for GL(2) coefficients. The device should give no help; this is a 'should not help' control, not a proved-false one.

precedent_check.verdict: No earlier equivalent of the sextic-twist Mobius <-> cubic-theta duality found (snippet-level searches; consistent with the novelty pass). Closest: Dunn-Radziwill 2024 (same objects, prime sums, GRH-conditional dispersion; Heath-Brown's cubic large sieve is sharp under GRH), Heath-Brown 2000 / Hasse (identity only), Gao-Zhao (quadratic analogue without automorphic dual). No downgrade.
